name: XlParameterType
description: Specifies how to determine the value of the parameter for the specified query table.

constants.name: xlPrompt
constants.description: Displays a dialog box that prompts the user for the value. The _Value_ argument specifies the text shown in the dialog box.

constants.name: xlConstant
constants.description: Uses the value specified by the _Value_ argument.

constants.name: xlRange
constants.description: Uses the value of the cell in the upper-left corner of the range. The _Value_ argument specifies a Range object.
